termosDoc.s1Body: By accessing and using the The Magic Trader platform, the user agrees to these Terms of Use. If you do not agree with any of the terms, you should not use the platform.
termosDoc.s2Body: The Magic Trader is a Forex market technical analysis platform that uses artificial intelligence and technical indicators to generate educational analysis. The signals provided are based on statistical models and should not be considered financial advice.
termosDoc.s3Body: All content available on the platform is of an exclusively educational and informational nature. We are not responsible for investment decisions made based on the analysis provided.
termosDoc.s4Body: The user is responsible for keeping their access credentials confidential. A premium account is personal and non-transferable.
termosDoc.s5Body: Premium subscriptions are processed via Stripe. Plans are automatically renewed at the end of each billing period, unless cancelled before the renewal date.
termosDoc.s6Body: All content on the platform, including but not limited to texts, graphics, logos, software and analysis, is owned by The Magic Trader and is protected by copyright.
termosDoc.s7Body: We reserve the right to change these terms at any time. Changes take effect immediately after publication on the platform.

privacidadeDoc.s1Body: We only collect the data necessary for the platform to function: email address, username (when provided via Google OAuth) and payment data processed directly by Stripe.
privacidadeDoc.s2Body: Your data is used exclusively for: authentication, managing your subscription, sending notifications related to your account, and improving the experience on the platform.
privacidadeDoc.s3Body: Data is securely stored via Supabase (PostgreSQL) with encryption in transit and at rest. We do not store payment data directly.
privacidadeDoc.s4Body: We do not share, sell or transmit your personal data to third parties, except when required by law or for payment processing through Stripe.
privacidadeDoc.s5Body: We use essential cookies for the platform to function and authentication cookies managed by Supabase. We do not use third-party tracking cookies.
privacidadeDoc.s6Body: You can request the deletion of your personal data at any time by contacting us. You have the right to access, rectify and delete your personal data.
privacidadeDoc.s7Body: For privacy questions, contact us through the platform's support email.

avisoRiscoDoc.intro: Trading financial products involves significant risks and is not suitable for all investors. You should carefully consider your investment objectives, experience level and risk tolerance.
avisoRiscoDoc.s1Body: The Forex market and other financial markets are highly volatile. There is a significant risk of partial or total loss of invested capital. Never invest money you cannot afford to lose.
avisoRiscoDoc.s2Body: The analysis and signals provided by the The Magic Trader platform are of an exclusively educational and informational nature. They do not constitute a recommendation to buy, sell or subscribe to any financial instrument.
avisoRiscoDoc.s3Body: We do not guarantee the accuracy, completeness or timeliness of the analysis provided. AI models and technical indicators may generate incorrect signals. Past results are not indicative of future results.
avisoRiscoDoc.s4Body: Any investment decision is the sole responsibility of the user. We recommend consulting a professional financial advisor before making any investment decision.
avisoRiscoDoc.s5Body: Leveraged trading amplifies both profits and losses. You can lose more than your initially invested capital. Make sure you fully understand the associated risks before trading.
avisoRiscoDoc.s6Body: The Magic Trader is not a licensed broker and does not execute trading orders directly. To trade in the Forex market, you must use a regulated broker.
